title: Lesson 1 Quiz: Defining Your Strategy and Entry Rules

questions.text: What must a precise entry trigger be for the described strategy?
options: A candle that looks strong on the chart
A clean break and retest of a key intraday support/resistance level, entered only when the candle closes completely past the level
Entering as soon as price moves in any direction
questions.explanation: The strategy requires a clean break and retest of a key intraday support/resistance level with a close past the level.

questions.text: The invalidation point is where the setup is dead and where the stop loss should be placed; if price crosses back over the structure line, the reason for the trade is gone.
questions.explanation: The invalidation point marks where the setup fails, and crossing back over the structure line nullifies the trade rationale.
